cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: I want us the biggest seller of {calc} in London, 35% at least. You're on {share}% and {rival} is the one to beat. The biggest seller sets the price and everyone else follows. I'd rather set it than follow it.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Take first place on {calc}, with a 35% share. We're at {share}% and {rival} is in the way. The top seller doesn't get pushed around by anyone's price swing. That's the security I want.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Be the largest seller of {calc}, at 35% or better. You're on {share}%, and {rival} is the biggest other name. First place means the price is partly ours to move, and we'll have more spare to give away.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: First place on {calc}: 35% and the biggest share in town. You hold {share}%. {rival} sits just behind. Whoever leads decides what the market does, so I'd like it to be us, not them.
